payload.summary_en: Nominations lodged between 1 July 2026 and 30 June 2027 for SID 482 Core Skills, ENS 186, and 494/187 must meet at least $79,423 (up from $76,515) alongside Annual Market Salary Rate (AMSR) requirements.

payload.statutory_authority: Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) ss 333, 382(b)(iii), 392(5); Fair Work Regulations 2009 reg 2.13
payload.summary_en: Effective 1 July 2026, the Fair Work High Income Threshold increased from $183,100 to $190,100, and the maximum unfair dismissal compensation cap (26 weeks, s 392(5)) rose to $95,050.
payload.summary_ko: 2026년 7월 1일부터 현대 노사협약(Modern Award)이나 기업협약 적용을 받지 않는 근로자의 부당해고 구제신청(s 394, 해고 후 21일 절대기한) 고소득 기준이 $190,100로 상향되었으며, 최대 보상상한(26주분)은 $95,050입니다.
payload.title_en: Fair Work High Income Threshold & Unfair Dismissal Compensation Cap (FY2026–27)
payload.title_ko: 공정근로위원회(FWC) 부당해고 고소득 상한(High Income Threshold) 및 보상상한 개정

payload.summary_en: The Specialist Skills Income Threshold (SSIT) for SID 482 nominations lodged from 1 July 2026 increased from $141,210 to $146,576 (excluding ANZSCO/OSCA trade occupations).
payload.summary_ko: 직업군 목록 제한 없이 고소득 전문인력을 스폰서하는 SID 482 Specialist Skills 스트림 소득기준이 2026년 7월 1일부터 $146,576(종전 $141,210)로 상향되었습니다(현장 기능직 Trade 직군 제외).
